d: Atrium of the castle of Pavia. It is night: many Gothic Warriors sleep on the ground. Lausco is standing leaning on a column, motionless and thoughtful. From the bottom they advance cautiously Teodato and Svarano.
Rich room in the castle of Pavia; at the bottom a large verone from which you can see the plain and in the distance the Apennines; two side doors. Amalasunta alone.
A Gothic room in the castle of Pavia. A door at the bottom. Teodato solo.
The great plain of Pavia: you can see the city very far away. On the one hand there will be a throne made up of trophy of arms. Sveno, then Gualtiero.

At the sound of triumphal march the Warriors, the Princes, the Priests, the Conspirators, the People are advancing. Then preceded by a group of Guards Amalasunta and Theodate clothed with royal insignia; then Lausco, Svarano and other Warriors. Sveno and Gualtiero are confused among the crowd; the People send festive cries.

Half-dirked room of a castle on Lake Trasimeno. At the bottom of the right a staircase leads to the terrace of an old tower from which there is a strip of sky, furrowed by black clouds. To the left also on the bottom two doors which open to see the lake. Two other side doors. It is stormy night. A light lamp weakly derailed the scene. Amalasunta sitting, surrounded by a dark silence: some Damigelle are around her.
Sveno followed by some Roman Warriors and Amalasunta.
You hear the far-off drum of arms and the sound of the dagger. Bridesmaids rushing in terrified.
